name: Reliability: launch, load, one turn, save, reload, exit

steps.code: local r=GameInfo.GlobalParameters['JAC_POC_BUNDLE0_VERSION']; if not r or tostring(r.Value)~='1' then error('minimal mod database missing') end; JAC_RELIABILITY_START_TURN=Game.GetCurrentGameTurn(); return tostring(JAC_RELIABILITY_START_TURN)

if Game.GetCurrentGameTurn()~=JAC_RELIABILITY_START_TURN+1 then error('must advance exactly one turn') end; local s=Game:GetProperty('JAC_POC_BUNDLE0_STATE'); if type(s)~='table' then error('minimal mod script missing') end; return tostring(Game.GetCurrentGameTurn())..'|'..tostring(s.FirstTurn)..'|'..tostring(s.LastTurn)..'|'..tostring(s.TurnsSeen)

local s=Game:GetProperty('JAC_POC_BUNDLE0_STATE'); if type(s)~='table' then error('minimal mod script missing after reload') end; return tostring(Game.GetCurrentGameTurn())..'|'..tostring(s.FirstTurn)..'|'..tostring(s.LastTurn)..'|'..tostring(s.TurnsSeen)
